_comment: Self-authored 'calendar as it stands today' (the PDF's seed table was confirmed missing). As of Mon 2026-08-24. Includes the three launches the update messages assume exist: saved views, onboarding checklist, bulk export.

launches.title: Saved views
launches.feature_brief: Save and share filtered views of the contract repository. Relies on a third-party search vendor.

launches.title: Onboarding checklist
launches.feature_brief: In-app checklist that walks new workspaces through first upload, first review, first playbook.

launches.title: Bulk export
launches.feature_brief: Export reviewed contracts and extracted fields in bulk to CSV/ZIP.

launches.title: Connectors Platform
launches.feature_brief: Shared auth, sync and permissions layer that every storage/CRM connector is built on.
launches.audience: Internal; ships to customers through individual connectors

launches.title: Playbook builder redesign
launches.feature_brief: Rebuilt playbook editor with clause-level rules and live preview.
launches.audience: Open beta for all customers; GA with launch webinar
launches.risk_note: Beta feedback on rule conflicts may add a sprint

launches.title: Clause library search
launches.feature_brief: Semantic search across the clause library.

launches.title: SCIM user provisioning
launches.feature_brief: Automated user provisioning from Okta / Entra ID.
